title: 第13章 大型网抑云现场-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》
content:
第(1/3)页

    今晚，他的新歌将在QQ音乐发布。

    老狼那边有些人脉，到时候会给一些曝光。

    但这远远不够。

    《体面》需要更多曝光！！

    插上了U盘，里面存着前几天的唱歌视频。

    他的想法很简单，发布这段唱歌录像。

    不仅如此，他还要写一篇软文，给这个录像加上一层BUFF。

    有上辈子做网红的经验，魏沐知道写什么东西才能获得关注。

    现在是2008年，一个深情还不被当成舔狗的时代。

    沸羊羊、黑小虎、双面龟，汤姆猫还只是普通的动漫人物，没有被赋予其他意义。

    隐去了真实姓名，然后再对两人的感情进行一番描绘。

    半个小时后，不到600字的小作文出炉。

    标题就用歌词《分手应该体面，谁都不要说抱歉》

    随后，他又在其他社交网站上如法炮制。

    做完这一切，又等了一会。

    魏沐才按下了回车键。

    .........

    2008年3月27号，周四

    林筱拖着疲惫的身体回到了出租屋。

    脱掉鞋子，回到卧室，她一头栽倒在床上。

    又是徒劳无功的一天。

    她是一名即将毕业的魔都大学生。

    今天是找工作的第八天，也是失败的第八天。

    其所在的学校虽然是一本，但她的专业却是环境科学与工程。

    环境科学与工程，听名字就很难就业。

    现在还没有四大填坑专业的说法。

    可当林筱看着手握好几个offer的计算机同学以及早就进单位的土木同学，她便满肚子怨气。

    踏马没有比这个专业更烂的了！！

    在床上趴了半个小时，被饥饿感叫醒。

    “张欢.....昨晚的...”

    话音刚落，林筱环顾四周，她眼中仅剩的光彩一点点黯淡。

    张欢是他的前男友，两人几天前分手，男友搬回了学校宿舍。

    分手的理由很简单，张欢想回到老家锡市工作，而她想留在大城市魔都。

    两个人从高中就是男女朋友，一直到大学毕业，连结婚的时间都想好了，没想到会败给现实。

    目光停留在空旷的天花板上，林筱眼里没有泪水，因为前几天已经流干了。

    晚上七点，收拾好心情的林筱打开了家中的电脑。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Tonight, his new song will be released on QQ Music.

“Lao Lang has some connections there, and they will be exposed when the time comes.

But this is far from enough.

"Decent" needs more exposure!!

Plug in the USB flash drive, which contains singing videos from the past few days.

His idea is simple, release this singing video.

Not only that, he also wants to write a soft article to add a layer of BUFF to this video.

Having the experience of being an Internet celebrity in his previous life, Wei Mu knows what to write to gain attention.

It’s 2008 now, an era when being affectionate is not considered a licking dog.

The Boiling Goat, the Black Tiger, the Two-faced Turtle, and Tom Cat are just ordinary cartoon characters and have not been given other meanings.

​The real names are hidden, and then the relationship between the two is described.

Half an hour later, a short composition of less than 600 words was published.

The title is based on the lyrics "Breaking up should be decent, no one should say sorry"

​Subsequently, he followed the same pattern on other social networking sites.

After doing all this, I waited for a while.

Wei Mucai pressed the enter key.

…........

Thursday, March 27, 2008

Lin Xiao dragged her tired body back to the rental house.

She took off her shoes, returned to the bedroom, and fell on the bed.

It’s another day of futility.

She is a college student in Shanghai who is about to graduate.

Today is the eighth day of job hunting and the eighth day of failure.

Although the school she is in is from the same school, her major is environmental science and engineering.

Environmental science and engineering, it is difficult to get a job just by the name.

There are currently no four major hole-filling professions.

But when Lin Xiao looked at the computer science students who had several offers and the civil engineering students who had already entered the unit, she was filled with resentment.

There is nothing worse than this major!!

I lay on the bed for half an hour and was woken up by hunger pangs.

"Zhang Huan...last night..."

As soon as she finished speaking, Lin Xiao looked around, and the light left in her eyes dimmed a little.

Zhang Huan is his ex-boyfriend. The two broke up a few days ago and the boyfriend moved back to the school dormitory.

The reason for the breakup was simple. Zhang Huan wanted to return to her hometown of Xishi to work, while she wanted to stay in the big city of Magic City.

The two have been boyfriend and girlfriend since high school until they graduated from college. They even thought about the time to get married, but they didn't expect that they would lose to reality.

Lin Xiao’s eyes stayed on the empty ceiling. There were no tears in Lin Xiao’s eyes because they had dried up in the past few days.

At seven o'clock in the evening, Lin Xiao, who was in a good mood, turned on the computer at home.
